authority_order.rule: Final authority for state-specific composition, hierarchy and visible copy.
Behavior, interaction, CTA and implementation-facing state contract.
Shared Result visual language/base composition. Does not override a state-specific Frozen reference.
Real pipeline/state routing authority. Result visuals must not change model semantics.
Implementation must be corrected when it conflicts with higher authority.

conflict_rules: State-specific Frozen PNG wins over the Core Visual reference for state differences.
Result spec wins over runtime behavior when runtime is implementation debt.
Global Recognition Runtime Contract wins for classifier/detector/confidence semantics.
Missing runtime capability must be recorded as a gap; it must not silently rewrite design intent.
